S.rng_streams: SeedSequence([seed, world_index]).spawn(3) in source, adaptation, holdout order

r7_plan.selection: Change only the aggregate B0 mass anchor from one pseudo observation per adaptation graph to one pseudo observation for the whole adaptation pool. Keep the original shared model, posterior decision policy and scientific gates. Validate on a fresh fixed synthetic cohort.
r7_plan.finite_master_retry: If warm solve is invalid, one deterministic zero-start retry under the same objective, maxiter and verifier.
r7_plan.finite_master_multiplier_verification: Existing verifier first; rejected active cut multipliers may be recovered by a minimax residual LP and the same KKT gates.

single_cut_stationarity_refinement.when: Cold start, one cut, negative objective, only stationarity rejected, original iteration budget remaining
single_cut_stationarity_refinement.method: L-BFGS-B on the equivalent smooth risk plus the original L2 penalty after eliminating epigraph
single_cut_stationarity_refinement.acceptance: Original unscaled KKT, feasibility, no-worse-than-zero, and objective no larger than starting point within feasibility tolerance
single_cut_stationarity_refinement.controls: Identical S seeds, P graph IDs and seed pairs, beta, compatibility and metric gates
single_cut_stationarity_refinement.exhausted_budget_case: When the initial cold one-cut solve is invalid but has a finite negative objective and exhausts the epigraph budget, retry the exact smooth objective in original coordinates, with a separate identical numerical iteration budget and the same final certificate.

synthetic_replication.gate: Use the registered 80 percent criterion: 12 of 15 complete seeds in each positive world. Preserve all primary widths, risk and no-shift thresholds and all real stage gates.
synthetic_replication.purpose: Fresh complete S of the one fixed-count variant selected by the paired mechanism diagnostic on seeds 65–79. Preserve prior failures in their original archive.
